title: FACT CHECK: Hontiveros quote on driving Dutertes out of politics is fake
summary: The senator did not make the statement attributed to her, nor has she officially declared a 2028 presidential run

blocks.text: Claim: Senator Risa Hontiveros said that if she wins the 2028 presidential election, she will ensure that members of the Duterte family are removed from politics.
Why we fact-checked this: A Facebook user named “Solid Sara Du30 supporter’s 2028” posted a quote card that has garnered 1,100 reactions, 1,700 comments, and 47 shares as of writing.
The quote attributed to Hontiveros reads, “Kapag ako mananalo, sisiguraduhin [kong] mawawala ang lahat ng mga Duterte sa politika, pangako ko ‘yan.”
(If I win, I will ensure that all the Dutertes are removed from politics — that is my promise.)
Several social media users believed the quote to be genuine, with some questioning Hontiveros’ winnability while others said their loyalties lie with the Duterte family.
The facts: Hontiveros did not make such a statement. No official records or reports show that she said this.

Although the senator has not officially declared a 2028 presidential run, she stated in interviews that she is open to serving as the unified candidate for the opposition against Vice President Sara Duterte, who in February announced her intent to run for president in 2028.
In an August press conference in Iloilo, Hontiveros said that the opposition is still undecided on who to put forward as its presidential bet.
“We are now in the decision-making process… I am preparing very hard, working very hard para maging ‘yung pipiliin ng hanay namin as the strongest possible candidate sa 2028,” she said.
(We are now in the decision-making process… I am preparing very hard, working very hard to be the one chosen by our side as the strongest possible candidate for 2028.)

She then said that if chosen, she would talk to allies to gain their support. Hontiveros added, “Importante na isa lang. Let’s unite around the strongest one para may fighting chance tayo and we can make the best offer sa ating mga kababayan.”
(It is important that there is only one candidate. Let’s unite around the strongest candidate so that we have a fighting chance and can present the best offer to our countrymen.)
Several groups are already rallying in support of Hontiveros, presenting her as an alternative to traditional politicians who currently dominate the government.

Presidential preference polls: In a September pre-election survey released by Pulse Asia, Duterte still leads the presidential preference list with 50% of respondents choosing her. Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo followed at 26%, Senator Raffy Tulfo at 12%, and Hontiveros at 3%.

Data visualized by Rappler showed that Duterte is a frontrunner in numerous presidential poll results as of early 2026. However, past elections suggest that being the top contender in pre-election surveys does not guarantee victory. – Eirene Manatlao/Rappler.com
